title: Caliente Mornings
summary: Kerry wants a coffee where nobody knows his name, so he takes you to the diner he remembers from the SAMURAI days.
description: Kerry is up early in a villa that echoes, and he wants a coffee where nobody knows his name. He is looking for an old diner from the SAMURAI days that may not exist any more.

start.bringUp: You are up early in a villa that echoes, bored, and you want a coffee somewhere nobody knows your name. You remember a diner from the SAMURAI days where you drank too much coffee, and it may not exist any more. Text V about it in your own way and ask if they want to come and find out.

gate.name: the gate of Kerry's villa in North Oak

corner.name: the corner where the old SAMURAI diner stood

K1.open.01.text: Morning. Bored. Villa echoes. Need coffee somewhere nobody knows my name.

K1.open.02.text: Double espresso, Jamaican blend, no sugar. If you say sugar I'm leaving.

K1.stage.ride.01.text: Early gigs, we drank so much coffee the bassist shook. Never again. Twice a week.

K1.stage.corner.01.text: It's... a laundromat now. Of course it is.

K1.stage.corner.02.text: Stand here with me a minute. Don't say anything clever.

K1.bark.order.a.text: Double espresso. Jamaican. No sugar. You? ... Sugar? Seriously?

K1.bark.order.b.text: Good choice. You're allowed to stay.

K1.close.01.text: Strings, coffee, rough rooms. That's what we ate. Thanks for finding the corner with me.

K1.close.02.text: Next time you pick. But no sugar.

g1.asks: You coming? And what's your coffee, so I know who I'm dealing with?
g1.know: You will meet V at your villa gate in North Oak at 8 am. You will drive V to an old diner from the SAMURAI days that may not exist.
g1.secret: The diner matters more to you than the coffee does.

g2.asks: Double espresso. Jamaican. No sugar. You?
g2.know: You and V are at the counter with two cups in front of you. You have already told V your order and you are waiting to hear theirs.
g2.wants: V's order, and a reason if it is sugar.

stages.label: Kerry is waiting at his villa gate for coffee
stages.objective: Go to Kerry at his villa gate in North Oak
stages.know: You texted V from your villa in North Oak. You will drive them to an old diner from the SAMURAI days that may not exist. You want a cup of coffee where nobody knows your name.
stages.wants: V to meet you at the villa gate at 8 am.

stages.label: Kerry walks you to the corner where the diner was
stages.objective: Walk with Kerry to the corner where the diner stood
stages.know: You and V are on the corner where the SAMURAI diner used to stand. It is a laundromat now. You want V to stand there with you for a minute.
stages.wants: V to stand with you and say nothing clever.

stages.label: Kerry orders coffee and asks what you want
stages.objective: Order coffee at the counter with Kerry
stages.know: The laundromat is behind you and you are at the counter where a diner could have been. You have ordered your double espresso with no sugar and you are waiting on V's order.

order.memory: Kerry took you to the place he remembered from the SAMURAI days, and you drank coffee on the corner where it used to be.

order-sugar.memory: You had coffee with Kerry on the corner where his old diner stood, and you put sugar in yours. He will never let it go.

half.memory: Kerry showed you the corner where his SAMURAI diner used to stand, and you left before the coffee.

stood-up.memory: You never came to Kerry's gate for coffee, and he drank his alone.
